content: Nothing can bring you peace but yourself. Nothing can bring you peace but the triumph of principles.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: External circumstances and material conquests cannot provide enduring tranquility. True peace is the internal alignment of your conduct with timeless moral principles.
practicalInsight: When feeling agitated, identify whether your actions have drifted from your deepest values, and recalibrate.
reflectionPrompt: What moral compromise is disturbing your internal serenity right now?
